text:
ashok: Heads-up — we saw a spike in pod evictions and NodeLost alerts across the gpu-mixed nodepool after last night's rollout. Most evictions look like spot preemptions. Anyone oncall?

maria_p: On it. Can you paste the TF snippet that was applied? capacityType=SPOT or mixed policy change?

ashok: Pasting the relevant snippet from the module applied by CI:
```hcl
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo//modules/node-pool"
  mixed_instances_policy = true
  override_instance_types = ["g4dn.xlarge", "g5.xlarge", "p3.2xlarge"]
  capacity_type = "SPOT"
}
```
ci-bot: terraform apply completed at 2026-03-18T01:12:22Z — ASG replaced 12 instances (rolling). Plan: replace 12 to match mixed instance policy.

devon: Quick notes from k8s events: a lot of `Preemption` + `Evicted` for pods scheduled on newly created spot nodes. Also saw a mismatch in taint/key — some pods expect `gpu=true:NoSchedule` but nodes are tainted `nvidia.com/gpu:NoSchedule`. That caused reschedules to non-gpu nodes then eviction when resources weren't available.

kevin_sre: Oof. Two immediate mitigations: 1) bring up an on-demand fallback pool and cordon/taint new spot nodes; 2) revert the mixed-instance change until we have pod placement fixes and an eviction policy.

maria_p: I'm opening a hotfix GitOps PR to pin the canary gpu nodegroup to ON_DEMAND and add explicit taints/labels to the TF module so Helm charts pick them up. Will also add lifecycle ignore for mixed_instances_policy until we validate.

ashok: Thanks. Our production workload can't tolerate >30% spot eviction rate during autoscaling. For context, the autoscaler group scaled up during the rollout and most scaled members were spot (eviction window ~15-45m).

devon: Also noticed ArgoCD didn't reconcile the new taints -> some pods (model-serving) don't have tolerations because our helm values were using the old key. Quick diff: helm values had `nodeTaint: gpu=true:NoSchedule` while TF now emits `nvidia.com/gpu:NoSchedule`.

kevin_sre: Actionable checklist: 
- revert TF mixed_instances_policy (maria).
- create `gpu-on-demand` nodegroup, min=2, capacityType=ON_DEMAND (ashok + infra runbook).
- update helm chart values to use `nvidia.com/gpu` and add tolerations (devon).
- add Prometheus alert for spot eviction spikes + dashboard panel (kevin).
- add TF integration test for mixed instance behavior in staging (devon).

maria_p: PR created: https://git/repo/pull/1234 — gitops pipeline triggered, ArgoCD will sync after merge. Terraform plan shows replacing 8 instances. 

ci-bot: terraform plan summary: 8 to be replaced, 0 to be created, 0 to be destroyed. Run by maria_p.

ashok: Once PR merges, please don't let CI auto-apply on production until we've validated the fallback pool. I'll coordinate a short maintenance window. :thumbsup:

devon: FYI I'm also adding a small probe in the rollout job to detect spot-termination-notices and fail early so we don't complete canaries that lost capacity mid-check.

kevin_sre: Good call. After this we should document recommended nodegroup profiles for GPU workloads (min on-demand buffer, toleration key, and a NodeAffinity example). I'll own a short RFC.

ashok: Thanks team. I'll follow up with an incident blameless postmortem once we stabilize.

ci-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026-214 created for follow-up and dashboard tracking.
